column3: (俨然) solemn, neatly arranged, just like
to go shopping, to buy things
more or less, to some extent
of all sizes, big and small alike
just right, neither too much nor too little
to turn something over in one's mind
little by little, bit by bit
to study hard, to apply oneself
up and down; all levels, everyone
the whole business, from start to finish
to look this way and that
to talk round and round in circles
